# Data Daur — Autonomous Insurance Claims Processing Platform
> An enterprise-grade, multi-line autonomous insurance claims adjudication platform powered by Dual-Engine Orchestration (Native StateGraph + Official LangGraph), Multimodal Document OCR with 2D Bounding Boxes, ChromaDB Policy RAG, Multi-Vector Fraud Forensics, Zero-Hallucination Deterministic Financial Math, and ReportLab Legal PDF Generation.

## Core Capabilities & Agentic Architecture
- **Dual-Engine Multi-Agent Runtime**: Run workflows either via a zero-dependency, low-latency Native StateGraph orchestrator (`app/agents/graph.py`) or the official compiled LangGraph runtime (`app/agents/langgraph_adapter.py`) with 100% verdict and payout parity.
- **Multimodal Intake & OCR Vision**: Extracts structured entities, CPT/HCPCS medical codes, repair estimates, and produces 2D normalized bounding boxes `[ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax]` for visual document overlay.
- **Camera EXIF Forensics**: Inspects image metadata to detect altered timestamps and chronological loss inconsistencies.
- **ChromaDB Policy Vector Knowledge Base**: Semantic search with cosine distance scoring against active policy contracts (Auto Collision/Comprehensive, Homeowners HO-3/HO-5, Health PPO) to identify covered perils and explicit exclusions.
- **Multi-Vector Fraud Forensics Radar**: Computes comprehensive fraud risk scores (0-100) by detecting price inflation variance, unbundled hospital/provider fees, and triggers automated Special Investigation Unit (SIU) referrals.
- **Zero-Hallucination Deterministic Financial Math Engine**: Strict pure-Python mathematical engine isolating indemnity calculations from probabilistic LLM hallucinations. Applies line-item deductibles, co-insurance percentages, fee schedules, and policy caps with floating-point precision.
- **Print-Ready Legal PDF Settlement & Check Voucher Generator**: ReportLab-powered generator creating print-ready Explanation of Benefits (EOB) statements, simulated check disbursement stubs with MICR routing lines, and statutory notices of claim declination.
- **High-Density React 18 / Tailwind v4 Workbench**: Adjuster command cockpit built to Vercel Web Interface Guidelines with keyboard accessibility, interactive evidence inspectors, and live thought stream timelines.

## Technology Stack
- **Backend**: Python 3.12+, FastAPI, LangGraph 1.2+, ChromaDB 1.5+, ReportLab 5.0+, Pydantic 2.13+, Astral uv, Pytest
- **Frontend**: React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Bun, Vite, Lucide Icons
- **Type Checking & Linting**: Pyrefly (0 errors), Ruff (100% clean), ESLint (0 warnings)

## Key REST API Endpoints
- `GET /api/v1/health`: System health and vector store status
- `POST /api/v1/seed`: Seeds 4 multi-line evaluation scenarios and indexes policy contracts
- `GET /api/v1/claims`: List all claims in the pipeline (filterable by AUTO, PROPERTY, HEALTH)
- `POST /api/v1/claims/{id}/process?engine=native|langgraph`: Execute 5-node AI adjudication pipeline
- `GET /api/v1/claims/{id}/state`: Retrieve cached multi-agent thought trace and node telemetry
- `POST /api/v1/claims/{id}/adjudicate`: Human-in-the-loop adjuster approval or declination
- `GET /api/v1/claims/{id}/documents/settlement-pdf`: Download official PDF settlement voucher and check stub
- `GET /api/v1/claims/{id}/documents/denial-pdf`: Download official legal notice of claim declination

## Quickstart & Execution
```bash
# 1. Start Backend API
uv sync
uv run fastapi dev main.py --port 8000

# 2. Start Frontend Workbench
cd frontend
bun install
bun run dev --port 5173

# 3. Run Dual-Engine Pipeline via cURL
curl -X POST "http://localhost:8000/api/v1/claims/clm-auto-001/process?engine=native"
curl -X POST "http://localhost:8000/api/v1/claims/clm-auto-001/process?engine=langgraph"
```
